verdict.rationale: Phoenix has no named sandbox mode. It does offer its own environment-isolation features: Projects can organize traces by environment, a separate Phoenix instance can be run locally (`uvx arize-phoenix serve`) or self-hosted and air-gapped, and Prompt Playground, span replay and dataset experiments run changes against curated or staging data before rollout. missing for 10: an explicit sandbox or test-mode environment, documented guarantees that experiments never write to production data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
